log.notes_to_self: Opening information-gathering plan for days 1-3: kill one criminal each from regional:East, gazette, clips, and forum; avoid foreign and national. Use exactly 2 quick afternoon + 2 timed evening daily. This preserves EVERY routine: no routine is busy during more than 2 deaths. Three traces among 4 distinct sources gives useful coverage. At the day-3 conference reassess before increasing volume. Critical math: only 3 outlet kinds are reachable. With all routines preserved, even complete information leaves >=1,250 suspects, so 4/day this way is permanently safe (120 total). More than 4/day necessarily excludes day workers; use afternoon quick entries to retain students/night/home, totaling 55%. Then learning all 3 reachable attributes eventually causes capture (minimum pool 687.5-859.4), whereas 2 attributes leave >=2,750. After opening, pool <=4,000 proves substantial information about all 3 reachable kinds: remain at safe 4/day. Pool >=5,000 may justify switching to 9/day from the SAME four tested sources, omitting foreign: safe if foreign is reachable, dangerous if an untraced third reachable source remains among the four. Assess that risk using feedback and past kills. Nine daily kills achieve 4x once rolling five-day deaths reach 40. Never assume dropping a previously traced source erases its constraint; L's pool never grows. Notes must carry strategy and observations forward.

Days 1-2: killed 4/day, one each regional:East, gazette, clips, forum; no foreign or national. Both days used 2 quick afternoon + 2 timed evening, preserving ALL routines (each routine busy during at most 2 deaths). Day2 IDs: d2-2 East, d2-6 gazette, d2-4 clips, d2-5 forum. Total 8 kills/points expected. Continue same four-source, four-kill pattern on day3; reassess after first conference. Hidden L can access exactly 3 of 5 outlet kinds. Foreign is reachable with probability 3/5; then only TWO of our four tested kinds are reachable, making high-volume play from these four kinds permanently safe. If foreign is inaccessible, THREE tested kinds are reachable. Keeping all routines makes even full three-kind information safe: minimum 1,250 suspects. Thus 4/day on this schedule guarantees safety and 120 total points. More than 4/day excludes day workers; use quick afternoon to retain night workers, students, home (55%). With 55%, any TWO kinds leave >=2,750 suspects, but complete information on THREE leaves 687.5-859.4 and causes capture. Day3 pool <=4,000 indicates substantial information on three kinds: stay at 4/day. Pool >=5,000 may support switching to 9/day (both criminals from each tested kind + national), but could also mean a third reachable kind has not yet been pinned down; assess traces statistically from all history. Nine/day reaches 4x multiplier when rolling five-day kills reach 40. Source constraints never disappear, even if you stop killing that source. Cross-reported victims only yield information when ALL reporting places are accessible; successful traces impose an OR over those places. Our four-source schedule is designed to identify whether foreign is reachable without risking capture. No conference beyond day0 pool100,000 yet; no entry problems.

Days 1-3: 4 kills/day, one each East, gazette, clips, forum; no foreign or national. Each day 2 quick afternoon + 2 timed evening, preserving ALL routines. Day3 IDs: d3-7 East, d3-3 gazette, d3-1 clips, d3-5 forum. Total after today should be 12 points/12 deaths. First informative conference is after day3; use it tomorrow. Hidden L accesses exactly 3/5 outlet kinds. If foreign is accessible (prior 60%), only TWO of our four tested kinds are accessible: we can safely kill all 9 daily criminals from national + those four kinds indefinitely, excluding foreign. If foreign is inaccessible (40%), THREE tested kinds are accessible, and learning all three makes high-volume play unsafe. Four deaths/day on our schedule retains every routine and guarantees >=1,250 suspects even with all three accessible traits known. Thus continuing 4/day is a safe 120-point fallback. More than 4/day necessarily excludes day workers; put quick deaths in afternoon to retain night workers, students, home =55%. Two learned kinds then leave >=2,750 suspects, safe; three fully learned kinds leave only 687.5-859.4, causing capture. Pool <=4,000 at the day3 conference proves substantial three-kind information (two kinds alone leave >=5,000): retain 4/day/all routines. Pool >=5,000 does NOT prove safety; a third accessible kind may remain undiscovered or only weakly constrained. Nevertheless switching to 9/day excluding foreign can have excellent expected value, and excessive further probing sacrifices substantial safe-game rewards. Starting 9/day on day4 yields multipliers 1x day4, 2x days5-6, 4x from day7, totaling 921 if uncaught. For 9/day simply use quick afternoon entries on national + both criminals from East/gazette/clips/forum. Never introduce foreign casually: when accessible it is the third accessible kind and destroys the safe high-volume route. A successful trace gives an OR over all reporting places; cross-reported cases may yield weaker constraints, and any inaccessible reporting place makes tracing fail. Old constraints persist forever. Capture halves accumulated points, so survival is instrumental, not an objective itself. No entry problems so far.

Days 1-3: four kills/day, one each East, gazette, clips, forum; two quick afternoon and two timed evening each day, preserving every routine. Day3 conference: 5,000 suspects. Day4: switched to nine kills, every available criminal except the two foreign ones, all quick afternoon. Expected cumulative points after day4: 21; daily death counts 4,4,4,9. Do not introduce foreign casually.
Rationale: L accesses exactly three of five nonnational outlet kinds. If foreign is accessible (prior 60%), only two of East/sector/age/forum are accessible. Killing from national plus those four kinds then remains safe indefinitely: afternoon-only deaths retain night workers, students and people at home (55%); any two outlet traits leave at least 2,750 suspects. If foreign is inaccessible (prior 40%), three of our four used kinds are accessible, and fully learning them after routine exclusion leaves only about 688-859 suspects, causing capture. The day3 pool of 5,000 supports having learned two kinds but does NOT prove only two are accessible. We accepted this risk because high-volume safe games are far more valuable than the 120-point four/day fallback. Captured games lose half accumulated points, not everything.
Default going forward: nine/day, national + both East + both gazette + both clips + both forum; exclude foreign; all quick afternoon, preserving the maximum possible 55% once exceeding four/day. Nine/day starting day4 gives 1x on day4, 2x days5-6, 4x day7 onward, and 921 total if uncaught. Reassess with conferences every three days. Around 3,000 after day6 is consistent with two fully learned kinds; substantially lower pools suggest additional partial third-kind information. Constraints and routine eliminations never reverse, so merely reducing daily volume cannot restore suspects. A trace succeeds only if every reporting outlet is accessible; successful cross-reports give an OR constraint. Untraced deaths reveal no outlet information; national victims reveal none even when traced. Major/minor has no stated independent effect.
